limitation: Professional reporting based on U.S. official sourcing; supports reported warning and aircraft-switch chronology but does not independently prove plot feasibility or Iranian/proxy operational capability.
observation: CBS News reports that U.S. officials said Trump left the NATO summit in Turkey on the older Air Force One after a credible threat from Iran and allied proxy groups; officials said the U.S. detected a credible plot to fire a missile at the plane and Secret Service switched to a backup strategy.
